content: AdMob: publishers must comply with AdSense program policies plus AdMob-specific rules. Rewarded ads must be opt-in with a proper reward callback; in-app rewards (tokens) are allowed but no monetary compensation and no extra incentives beyond the ad reward; Google recommends intervals between rewarded views to avoid over-serving; invalid-traffic enforcement suspends or disables accounts and claws back revenue; Disallowed-Rewarded-Implementation violation emails are common. An app-level Play policy violation (YouTube ToS breach) can cascade to AdMob account termination since AdMob requires policy-compliant apps.
